height.description: Even maximum output height; aspect ratio retained within integer rounding, never upscale. Copy requires native height already within this bound.

crf.description: Fixed encoder CRF; no guaranteed byte-size target. Inactive for video copy.

audio_kbps.description: Lossy AAC audio bitrate, preserving source rate/channels within admitted1..8 channel bounds.

codec.description: H.264 is the locally qualified default; HEVC is explicit opt-in. Copy accepts existing H.264/HEVC only, with no resize.

timeout_seconds.description: Total outer budget passed unchanged; worker operation D-10, shared cleanup<=5s plus5s reporting headroom. No hard realtime or kernel containment guarantee.
